excludedDirectoryReason: Resource textures/SDK/source backups/dependency test assets are not evidence screenshots. Explicit directory pruning prevents duplicate hardlinked Resource trees.
noGameScreenshotMeaning: No PNG in the inspected evidence families was established as an actual Client FPS screenshot. Real-game numeric captures are separate evidence; unclassified images are not promoted.

definitions.VS: Actual hardware vertex shader invocation count, not unique mesh vertices or VB capacity. Native geometry value is each case final measured frame.
definitions.Idx: Native Engine total indexed references includes actual direct + resolved indirect instances; mapIndices is tracked map color draws only. Position-only isolated model IA vertices/index references is a narrower scope.
definitions.FPS: Historical overlay=16-frame offscreen wall throughput, not instantaneous/gameFPS. New native proof includes serial EVENTdrain in walltime. Real-game capture frameInterval FPS requires valid Begin-to-Begin frame intervals.
definitions.timing: GPU timestamps are elapsed intervals, not pure shader busy time;16samples and geometryfinalframe are separate measurements.
